## v1.8.3

### Fixes
- **Update confirmation modal**: When updating the app, a confirmation modal now appears if any AI agents are currently running, asking whether to update now (interrupting agents) or wait until sessions finish.
- **Orchestrator no longer assumes a kanban board is attached**: The orchestrator handles the no-board case gracefully and works directly from user instructions when no board is present.
- **Orchestrator does git branch work itself**: The orchestrator now performs git operations (pull, branch creation, etc.) directly instead of delegating them to sub-agents.
- **Sub-agent command scoping**: Sub-agents only know about commands they can actually run — no more wasted declined attempts on commands they don't have access to.
- **Sub-agent lifecycle fixes**: Fixed a bug where sending a new message to the orchestrator could restart running sub-agents, and a bug where the orchestrator failed to spawn new sub-agents. The post-merge checker no longer falsely flags successful merges as failures, and spawning a new sub-agent while one is running now creates a new independent sub-agent.
